seasons.name: Winter
seasons.lawn: Stay off frozen turf, get a soil test, sharpen the mower blade and plan the nitrogen budget.
seasons.lawnWarm: The lawn is dormant: no fertilizer, light traffic. Get a soil test and spot-treat winter weeds before green-up.
seasons.beds: Leave stems and seed heads for birds and bees. Prune dormant trees and summer-flowering shrubs.
seasons.veg: Order seed, plan rotation, and start onions and then broccoli and cabbage under lights.
seasons.yard: Prune oaks while they are dormant, check trunk guards, clean tools and the rain barrel.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.lawn: Crabgrass preventer at redbud bloom; little or no nitrogen; start mowing as the grass grows.
seasons.lawnWarm: Crabgrass preventer before soil reaches 55°F. Hold the fertilizer until the lawn is fully green, then give the first feeding.
seasons.beds: Cut back grasses, clean up once highs hold in the 50s, mulch 2–3 in, divide summer and fall bloomers.
seasons.veg: Cool crops go in first; warm crops wait until a few weeks after the last frost. Then mulch and set drip lines.
seasons.yard: Ticks arrive, mosquito control starts, and it is time to treat ash trees where emerald ash borer is present.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.lawn: Mow high, water only to keep the lawn alive in a long dry spell, and watch for grubs and brown patch.
seasons.lawnWarm: Peak growing season: mow often, feed on schedule, water deeply when the lawn asks, and repair bare spots.
seasons.beds: Water new plantings weekly, deadhead, hand-pick Japanese beetles and pinch mums until early summer.
seasons.veg: Harvest often, watch for squash vine borers and hornworms, and sow the fall garden in late summer.
seasons.yard: Water young trees in dry spells; dump standing water weekly.

seasons.name: Fall
seasons.lawn: The main lawn season: aerate, overseed and feed. Mulch-mow leaves and spray broadleaf weeds.
seasons.lawnWarm: Last nitrogen 6–8 weeks before frost, then a fall pre-emergent. Watch for large patch as the soil cools.
seasons.beds: Plant trees, shrubs, perennials and spring bulbs. Leave some leaves in the beds.
seasons.veg: Harvest and cure, plant garlic, sow a cover crop, and clean up after the first frost.
seasons.yard: Drain hoses before the first hard freeze, service the mower, and guard young tree trunks.
